candidates.name: current_shared_prefix
candidates.description: Existing F0-like shared-prefix shape: block0 is register-handoff fused, while block1 remains behind the row-scratch boundary.
candidates.reason: This is the comparison baseline.  It is already correctness-safe and measured at the F0 envelope, but it does not remove block1 scratch traffic.

candidates.name: delayed_block1_prefix_checkpoint
candidates.description: Produce block0, checkpoint two out1-producing prefixes per stripe, run Stage345 block0, then form block1 directly in Stage345 block1 consumer registers.
candidates.reason: No raw q reloads, but the replacement is two prefix stores plus two prefix loads per stripe.  Net instruction estimate is positive and memory checkpointing becomes the primary mechanism.

candidates.name: partial_shared_prefix_q9_q21
candidates.description: Use q9 plus q21 as the only no-rewrite block0 survivors, and preserve the remaining block1 live-ins through memory.
candidates.reason: The theoretical best case is only a small negative instruction delta, requires a new producer liveness contract for q9/q21, and still relies on six memory-preserved vectors per row.  That is too weak after the measured B8/Bmin result matched F0.

candidates.name: recompute_small_prefix
candidates.description: After Stage345 block0, recompute only the small prefix needed for block1.  Under the no-raw-q-reload rule, this collapses to the same two-vector prefix checkpoint as G0b; allowing raw reloads would duplicate Stage12 input loads and is disallowed.
candidates.reason: With raw q reloads forbidden, recomputation needs saved prefixes and has the same cost as G0b.  With raw q reloads allowed, it would violate Track G's G1 rule and repeat the known negative two-pass shape.

decision.stop_reason: No modeled Track G candidate clears the plausibility bar under the first-wave constraints.  The only negative-delta option is a six-vector memory-preservation variant with a small estimated gain and a dependency on a new q9/q21 producer liveness contract; the delayed/recompute shapes are clearly positive instruction deltas.
